2.body:
# Skill center: browse, install, preview and publish skills over the cloud-adapter WS channel

Adds a consumer-facing skill experience to DigitalMate on top of the `skills.*` /
`assets.publish.*` RPC methods of the develop gateway, reusing the conversation's
single WebSocket. Two commits, both self-contained:

| # | Commit | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `feat(skills): add the phase-1 skill center over the cloud-adapter WS channel` | 27 files,  — plaza, my skills, detail, file preview, composer picker |
| 2 | `feat(skills): publish and zip-upload skills over the cloud-adapter WS channel` | 16 files, — publish an installed skill, import a local .zip |

## 1. Skill center (phase 1)

**Surfaces**

- **技能广场** — 26pt title with a glass search button, the 2-way segment (技能广场 / 我的技能),
  the develop category row, three featured sections (精选技能 / 精选团队技能 / 精选技能包, each
  rendered only when non-empty) and the floating 对话 / 发现 / 技能 bottom bar.
- **我的技能** — sub-tabs mirroring `skills.mySkillsTabs` (全部 / 启用 / 禁用 / 内置), grouped
  技能包置顶 / 内置 / 其他; the 内置 tab is also the install entry for uninstalled presets.
- **Skill detail** — two modes (below), plus a full-width 去试试.
- **Composer picker** — the entry under the composer `+`.

**Service layer (`cloud-adapter`)**

- `CloudSkillService` funnels every call through one `call()`: transport failures are unwrapped
  from the `CODE：error` string, business failures are detected via `payload.success === false`
  (`error_code`, `detail_key`, `detail`), and `definitive=false` is propagated so a timed-out
  write is reported as unconfirmed instead of failed.
- Parsing lives in exported pure functions (`parseSkillList`, `parseOnlineItems`,
  `parseSkillDetail`, `parseSkillFiles`, `parseSkillFilePreview`, `parseHubDetail`,
  `usableSkills`, `skillSourceLabel`, …) so the tolerant field fallbacks are unit testable.
- Error classification accepts the develop codes (`SKILL_BUILTIN_READ_ONLY`,
  `SKILL_ALREADY_EXISTS`, `SKILL_NAME_CONFLICT`, `SKILLHUB_INSTALL_FAILED`) and `detail_key`
  values such as `skills.clawhub.errors.skillAlreadyInstalled`.
- Timeouts: 30s default, 120s for installs (the gateway downloads and unpacks the package),
  30s for plaza recommend, 180s for the marketplace force-refresh.

**One shared WebSocket**

The deployed gateway allows one WebSocket per identity (a second handshake is rejected with
`409` + `{"code":"ALREADY_CONNECTED"}`, and query-string credentials get `401`). `CloudConnectionHub` /
`sharedCloudConnection()` therefore hand the conversation and the skill pages the same connection;
callers other than the conversation must not overwrite its callbacks or disconnect it.

**Plaza follows the develop client**

- Two `plugin_type` branches (`swarmskill` / `skill`) issued **in parallel** with `top_k=6` and
  `cache_mode=prefer_cache`; on a cold catalog miss (`state=miss` while refreshing) with no items
  it goes straight to the Hub once instead of waiting for the background fill.
- The pack section is fed by the `skillpack` entries carried in those two responses (no third request).
- Category ids mirror develop's `MARKETPLACE_CATEGORIES`.
- An in-process cache (keyed by gateway host **and** bearer identity, per category for the plaza)
  paints instantly on re-entry; stale entries revalidate silently; `CloudHome` prefetches the list
  plus the default category as soon as the connection opens. Pull-to-refresh and the long-press
  marketplace refresh bypass and update the cache.

**Detail page**

- *Local skill*: `skills.get` for metadata + SKILL.md, enable/disable toggle, overflow uninstall,
  基础信息, a display-only 版本管理 row, 内容详情, and a real **文件预览** tab backed by
  `skills.files.list` (workspace tree, `.archive` hidden) and `skills.files.get` (text preview up
  to 512KB; binary files report as not previewable inline).
- *Hub asset* (from a plaza card, installed or not): `skills.swarmskillshub.detail` by `asset_id`
  renders title / version / publisher / tags from the card it was opened from, fills 基础信息 from
  `short_desc` and 内容详情 from `detail_desc`; the only actions are **安装** (with the overwrite
  confirm) or, once installed, **去试试**.

**Composer picker and 去试试**

- The picker lists real skills through `CloudConversationActions.listSkills` →
  `CloudChatManager.skills()` → `skills.list`, filtered by `usableSkills()` (installed or local).
- 去试试 hands the skill to the shell composer and pops back to the conversation; sending passes the
  skill name in `chat.send`'s `params.skills` (which the backend uses directly as `skills_to_use`),
  and the chip is cleared only once the cloud accepts the message.

**Edition / preset handling**

- `skills.installed` is probed once per gateway host and cached; enterprise is inferred from a
  `FORBIDDEN` response, after which plaza search routes to the SPI source.
- Preset detection accepts `source_type === 'prebuilt'` as well as `is_builtin` / `is_builtin_source`.
- Refresh deliberately omits `refresh_marketplaces` by default: the backend runs a synchronous git
  clone/pull per marketplace, which outlives the fixed client timeout.

**Diagnostics** — `CloudTransport` mirrors its failure paths to hilog (raw `BusinessError` code and
message plus the close code/reason); the skill pages log their steps under the `SkillCenter` tag
(connect, edition probe, reload, plaza load, install and verify, files, hub detail).

## 2. Publish and zip upload

- **Publish** an installed skill through the develop `assets.publish.*` protocol
  (`local_status` → `describe` → `prepare` → `commit` → `status`/`records`) with the GitCode OAuth
  access token, driven from a new **发布** page reached from the skill detail.
- **Import a local `.zip`** by streaming it over the shared WS with `file.upload_chunk` and then
  `skills.import_upload`. The develop Web client uses the co-located HTTP endpoint
  `/file-api/skills/upload-temp` instead, but the deployed cloud gateway does not expose it
  (probed 404), so the app plays the role of the gateway's authenticated HTTP bridge. Chunk params
  (`upload_id` / `target_rel_path` / `data` / `final` / `resolved_path`) follow the server contract,
  and the 50MB / `.zip`-only limits are mirrored client-side.

## RPC surface used

`skills.list` / `installed` / `get` / `toggle` / `install` / `uninstall`,
`skills.online_search.search` / `install`, `skills.source.providers` / `search` / `install`,
`skills.skillnet.install` / `install_status`, `skills.clawhub.download`,
`skills.pack_member.install`, `skills.files.list` / `get`,
`skills.swarmskillshub.recommend` / `detail`, `skills.import_upload`, `file.upload_chunk`,
`assets.publish.describe` / `prepare` / `commit` / `status` / `records` / `local_status`,
plus `chat.send` with `params.skills`. Every method and field was checked against the develop
branch's `ReqMethod` table and handlers.

## Configuration

- Correct the verified-phone synchronization endpoint to use `www`, preserve custom configuration, and distinguish HTTP, response validation and network failures.
- Repair baseline test fixtures and required ArkTS narrowing after `await`; add authentication, lifecycle, isolation and cancellation regressions plus manual validation steps.

- 77 local Node test scripts: 1,478 tests passed, with no failures or skips.
- Fresh V8 line coverage: 76.4% (7,015/9,178), passing the unchanged 55% gate.
- Debug HAP assembly, ZIP integrity and signature verification passed.
- Commit messages were rewritten in English without changing any commit's source tree.

The user confirmed that the earlier manual Account Kit sign-in and Gateway token exchange worked on a device. The new automatic flow, real WSS business requests, session lifecycle and two-account isolation still require device acceptance testing. WSS testing is deferred at the user's request. AGC-to-Gateway token exchange is not implemented.

- Add regression coverage and repository documentation in `docs/features/background-task-notifications.md`.

Scope: these are local notifications backed by a live application process and WebSocket, not an OS remote-push integration. Background execution remains subject to the system's temporary-task limits and quotas. Process reclamation, force-stop, and offline delivery are not guaranteed.

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind test

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

The conversation path — input → send → cloud gateway → model → rendered reply — has no automated end-to-end coverage, so a break anywhere in it is only visible by hand. This PR adds the first device system test for that path. One case, the critical one: send `hi`, expect an ordinary reply.

- `scripts/conversation-hi-system-test.mjs` drives the real app over `hdc` + `uitest` (start, open a new conversation, type, tap send, poll for the reply, keep evidence) and prints `Tests run: N, Passed: M, Failed: K`.
- `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.mjs` keeps the judgement as pure functions over `dumpLayout` JSON, so it can be replayed and unit tested off-device. Five states: `pass` / `error` / `busy` / `echo` / `empty`. Candidates come from a baseline diff plus structure (`Row > Text` is chrome) and copy filters (assistant name, task progress, task arrow, timestamp, token stats, clock ticks, error copy). `error` is checked **before** `pass`, so a failure notice can never be read as a reply.
- Locators are semantic: stable `id` first, then the accessibility label, and **no coordinate fallback** — a geometry guess can tap any nearby control and still let the case "pass".
- The send button had no id in `dumpLayout` because `.id()` was set on a custom component instance, which renders no node of its own. `A2uiButtonView` now takes `@Prop buttonId` and applies it to its real container; `HomePage` passes `a2ui-home-send` / `a2ui-home-rich-send`. 14 lines, no layout change.
- `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.test.mjs` covers the judgement with 22 cases (including ones copied from real device node structures) and runs inside `node-ut` on every PR, so the rules cannot rot while no device is attached.
- `.github/workflows/ut.yml` adds the `device-st` job: `workflow_dispatch` only, gated by `vars.ENABLE_DEVICE_ST == 'true'`, on the self-hosted `harmonyos` runner, uploading screenshots + every layout dump + `report.json` as `device-st-evidence`. It is deliberately not wired to PR/push events: every run sends a real request to the backend and consumes account quota.
- Docs: `docs/ci.md` records the `device-st` prerequisites (device, login state, and why the job is manual only). The judgement rules are documented in `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.mjs` and covered by its test file.

Scope and limits: the case asserts that an ordinary reply arrived; it does not judge whether the reply is on topic, and replies carried only by images/cards are out of reach (tracked in the survey as backlog). `device-st` requires a device whose app already holds a logged-in account, and a build that carries the send-button id.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

No linked issue.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results (Function, performance, reliability, etc.)**:

- `node-ut` on Linux CI, commit `6c468d9` (identical tree to this PR): **1824 tests, 1817 passed, 0 failed**, line coverage **77.3%** ≥ 55% gate. [CI run 39232416938](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/39232416938)
- `hypium-ut` on the same runs: **2937 passed, 0 failure, 0 error**.
- `device-st`, manual dispatch on commit `2d7e743` (same content; the only later delta is the docs record): **Tests run: 4, Passed: 4, Failed: 0** on device `127.0.0.1:5555` — `ST01` 4.5s, `ST02` 4.3s, `ST03` 18.2s, reply latency 17.5s. Because the branch carries no coordinate fallback, that pass also proves the send button is reachable by id on device. Evidence artifact `device-st-evidence` (2.1 MB: screenshots, every layout dump, `report.json`). [CI run 39230328310](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/39230328310)
- Locally, before pushing: the id fix was verified end to end — `dumpLayout` reports `Stack #a2ui-home-send [1060,1481][1193,1614]` — and the case ran **4/4 green** repeatedly on the same build.
- Judgement regression: `node --test scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.test.mjs` → **22/22**, including a "never guesses by coordinates" guard.
- Flake seen while verifying, and why it is not a false pass: right after an app cold start the cloud session is not ready and the turn fails with the app's own `对话正在准备，请稍后重试。`; the judgement reports `error`, not `pass`. Re-running once the app is warm gives 4/4. Retry / quarantine / flake metrics for this class are in the survey's P0 list.

修复 Orbit 助手回复直接显示 Markdown、长表格内容被截断的问题。生成中的表格等待完整接收后再渲染；表格按实际内容自然换行，并逐行校验高度缓存，宽表支持横向滚动。 
 
  接入 Orbit 产物中心，支持跨可见会话汇总文件、搜索、按时间排序，以及复用现有文件预览和下载能力。
 
  验证： 
  - 本地工作区 253 项相关测试通过。 
  - DevEco debug 编译、打包和签名通过。 
  - 模拟器视觉验收通过。
